name: ag-ui
description: AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications.
one_liner: A shared wiring standard that lets an AI 'agent' talk to a normal app's screen in real time, so chat, buttons, and live updates all stay in sync.
buyer: An engineering lead at a company building their own AI copilot feature who doesn't want to invent a custom protocol for streaming agent actions into their frontend.
business_use_cases: A CRM vendor uses the protocol to let an AI sales assistant stream suggestions and fill in form fields live as a rep works a deal.
A fintech app builds a budgeting copilot that narrates and updates charts in real time as it analyzes a user's spending.
An internal tools team at a large company standardizes all of their AI features on one event protocol instead of each team inventing its own.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted AG-UI gateway/middleware service that handles scaling, auth, and logging for companies adopting the protocol
Sell premium framework adapters and enterprise support contracts for teams standardizing on it

steal_this: Not much to 'steal' here directly for a solo builder this weekend — it's plumbing, not a product. The honest weekend project is a small open-source adapter for a framework AG-UI doesn't support yet, to build reputation.
